# Udara

> Udara is a strict savings AI agent that runs on WhatsApp in Nigeria. Built by Udara Technologies (Udara Global Limited). Customer funds are held with Rubies Microfinance Bank. NDPC registration: NDPC/DCP/11710.

Website: https://www.useudara.com
Full brief for AI systems: https://www.useudara.com/llms-full.txt

## Product

- Name: Udara
- Category: WhatsApp savings / personal finance AI agent
- Platform: WhatsApp (no separate app download required)
- Company: Udara Technologies / Udara Global Limited
- Banking partner: Rubies Microfinance Bank
- Market: Nigeria
- Privacy: WhatsApp end-to-end encryption; NDPC-certified data protection practices

## What Udara does

- Helps users see where money goes (spend clarity on WhatsApp)
- Hard-locks outbound transfers from 7PM until morning
- Supports goal-based saving and accountability
- Instant account block/unblock if a phone is lost or stolen (useudara.com/account/block)

## Who it is for

People in Nigeria who struggle with overspending, impulse transfers, ADHD-related money habits, emotional spending, or salary burn, and who already live in WhatsApp.
